items.title: Silicon Valley Bank: three lessons from a historic bank collapse | Spiko
items.summary_short: On March 10, 2023, a $220 billion bank collapsed in less than 48 hours. Read the story of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB), one of the most important lessons in cash management in recent memory.
